_meta.description: Every supplier invoice from chemical-purchases.json cross-referenced against actual bank withdrawals in banking.json. Each invoice carries one of three statuses: PAID_FROM_KNOWN (we have the withdrawal line proving the payment account), BILLED_NOT_PAYMENT_CONFIRMED (we know whose Sims/Jabco account was billed, but not which bank account cut the check), UNKNOWN. The real loan-ownership math follows the CASH TRAIL, not the Sims billing name. Kyle noted 2026-11-11 that the earlier ownership-mismatch analysis was wrong because it used Sims billing labels instead of bank withdrawals.
_meta.method: Walk every row of chemical-purchases.json. For each distinct (supplier, invoice, date), check banking.json for a matching outflow by date + amount. If found, record the funding account. If not, flag as BILLED_NOT_PAYMENT_CONFIRMED and name the billing account. Grand totals at bottom show what we can account for and what still needs clarification.
